<subject>Component Order 2024</subject>
<body>
My name is Andrea Reeves and I am the Supplier Quality Lead for Annette Reid this year. I know that you were the component coordinators for your workcell(s) last year. I do not have confirmation as to who the component coordinators are for your workcells this year. Will you please respond to this email and let me know if you are a coordinator for a workcell this year? If you are not your workcell's coordinator, would you please (if you know) tell me who is this year's lead (please include the workcell number(s) in your return email). I have sent out three emails to the manufacturing leads today and would like to get the information to your workcell's lead as soon as possible. Thanks for your help!

Andrea Reeves  
Vice President  
Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd  
Tel: +44 117 4567 8901  
Email: andrea.reeves@kestrelaero.co.uk  
Unit 3, Aerospace Way, Bristol, BS34 7QL, United Kingdom
